info.title: AdLedger API
info.summary: Self-hosted ad attribution: which ad actually made you money.
info.description:
REST API of a self-hosted AdLedger install. Reporting endpoints read the same SQL as the dashboard and the MCP server, so numbers always agree.

**Authentication.** Create an API key in Settings → API & MCP and send it as `Authorization: Bearer al_...`. A dashboard session cookie also works for same-origin calls. Ingestion endpoints called by third parties (pixel, webhooks) are authenticated by their own site key, URL token or signature instead.

**Money** is always an integer in minor units (e.g. cents) plus an ISO 4217 currency code. **Dates** in query strings are `YYYY-MM-DD` in the workspace timezone (end inclusive); timestamps in responses are ISO 8601 UTC.

get.description: Liveness + database check for load balancers and uptime monitors. No authentication.

`overview` → KPI totals · `performance` → rows per campaign / ad group / ad · `timeseries` → one point per day · `channels` → credit per channel · `wasted-spend` → rows with meaningful spend and ROAS < 0.5 · `compare` → this period vs the previous period of equal length.

parameters.description: `performance` only: rows under this campaign (level=ad_group) or ad group (level=ad).

200.description: Report with the period, model, currency and timezone it was computed for.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on email or name.

get.description: Ordered touchpoints, leads and payments for one contact plus the revenue credit each attribution model gives.

post.description: Runs a sync for a connected provider immediately (scheduled syncs also run automatically). A provider that isn't connected or is disabled returns `status: skipped`.
Daily spend rows from any ad platform (Zapier, Make, n8n, scripts). Campaigns, ad groups and ads are created on the fly; re-sending the same day/entity replaces it. Up to 20,000 rows per request.
Conversions from any tool (WooCommerce plugin, Zapier, Make, your backend). Idempotent on `source` + `external_id`. Up to 5,000 events per request.

Endpoint of the website pixel (`/p/al.js`). Sent with `navigator.sendBeacon` as `text/plain` JSON to avoid a CORS preflight. Authenticated by the public site key; the request origin must match the site's domains. Bots are silently dropped.

403.description: Origin not allowed for this site.

204.description: CORS headers for the calling origin.

get.description: Example CSV for Settings → Import data.

post.description: Generic lead webhook for Typeform, Tally, Webflow, Jotform, Zapier or any form. Create one in Settings → Tracking; the URL token authenticates the call. Email, phone and name are auto-detected (or mapped in settings); send `al_vid` to link the visitor.
Receives Stripe events (charges, refunds, checkout sessions). Verified with the `Stripe-Signature` header. AdLedger registers this webhook in Stripe automatically when it can.

500.description: Processing failed; Stripe will retry (ingestion is idempotent).

post.description: Orders, payments and refunds from connected revenue platforms. Each provider's own signature scheme is verified. WooCommerce's `webhook_id=N` activation ping is acknowledged.

500.description: Processing failed; the platform will retry (ingestion is idempotent).

post.description: Model Context Protocol server for AI agents (Claude, Cursor, …). JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP; all tools are read-only. See docs/MCP.md for the tool list and client setup. `GET` and `DELETE` are also accepted per the transport spec.

200.description: JSON-RPC response (JSON or a single server-sent event).
